title: 1919 Prairie: a third gable at its north side's far end
items: At the alley end of Marshall Field Jr.'s house at 1919 Prairie Avenue, the garage now has a steep slate gable with a stone edge and a finial, like the two wings in front of it. All three old advertisement pictures of the house show that third gable, and the garage's flat tin roof is gone.
A third of those pictures, from the 1912 Chicago Blue Book, is now lined up with the model, so the house is checked against all three.

Still to come on this side: the small pinnacled dormers between the gables, and a closer look at the two wings' gables, which the pictures show nearer the street and taller than the 1911 fire-insurance map allows.
